name: ministore
description: MiniStore — in-memory key-value store (mini Redis) with a live dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ministore/protocol && npm run build --workspace @ministore/store-engine && npm run build --workspace dashboard && npm run build --workspace @ministore/cli
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @ministore/store-engine" "npm run dev --workspace dashboard"
